title: The Silver Slipper in Memphis and what a mule is
summary: Meeting Eddie Miller, Baduc and the Goodman band at the Claridge Hotel in Memphis; he explains a mule, a night's pay lost.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Getting paid: wages, scale and the pay envelope

blocks.x: I forget his first name. Harry, I think it was. Yeah. Harry Goodman. And they all came in. They came up. We were staying at the Claridge Hotel there in Memphis. And they all came through. They had had thirteen mules on the way from the west coast coming over trying to get back to New York.

A mule is where you play all night and the man just didn't take in the money. Yeah. Didn't take in enough to pay you. Pay you everything. What were you going to do? It was times when, so what? Kill me. You know? See for yourself. Yeah, that's right. What you want, blood? Yeah. Oh, man. Why did you quit playing?
